accepted_findings: There are zero creditable non-test first-party Customer-photo contributions.
The 89 target count exactly reproduces the supplied entity-level formula.
Stage 1 has no prompt-exposure denominator and cannot estimate conversion.
required_corrections: Exclude test, closed, internal, demo, and otherwise ineligible event traffic before reporting a real-user funnel.
Qualify targets at dish level rather than treating entity-level menu/photo co-occurrence as comparison readiness.
Require operating status, menu freshness and orderability, accessible useful Management evidence, reviewed provenance and rights, exact or strong item linkage, and duplicate clearance.
Instrument eligible prompt impression, open, upload start, cancel or client failure, authoritative API result, moderation and rights, attachment and dedupe, and verified comparison outcome.
Keep all behavioral conversion scenarios hypothetical until a bounded real-user exposure denominator exists.
